shellCommands.command: find app __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "---NEXTCONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts

grep -rn "deprecated" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js | grep -i "middleware\|proxy" | head -10; echo "===="; grep -rn "middleware.*deprecat\|deprecat.*middleware" node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/*.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10

grep -rn "ProxyConfig\|NextProxy\|type Proxy" node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== server exports ==="; cat node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

(timeout 90 npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; echo "=== HEAD / ==="; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP"; echo "=== GET / (2nd request) ==="; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i "x-request-id"; echo "=== GET /some/nested/path ==="; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/some/nested/path | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP"
grep -i "^\[" /tmp/next.log; echo "=== full log tail ==="; tail -12 /tmp/next.log
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json && echo "=== gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
